answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the knoll of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The canyon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the shale is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
